title: Primitive Recursive Unary Output
statement: The function sending each finite bit string $s$ to the list consisting of $\operatorname{rank}(s)$ copies of $1$ is primitive recursive, where $\operatorname{rank}(s)$ is the least-significant-bit-first binary value of $s$ with a final $1$ appended, minus $1$.
